作为临时的处理方案，我们可以提升[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的失业补助金。虽然可能会花费大量预算，但可以为我们争取宝贵的时间以制定永久的解决方案，例如创造更多工作岗位，提升失业与贫困民众的生活标准等。

当然我们也可以袖手旁观，但这很可能会造成[Root.GetName]上形成庞大的地下犯罪组织。
texts.en:
Unemployment and poverty are spreading at an alarming rate on [Root.GetName]. This sorry state of affairs is being exploited by local crime organizations, who find themselves awash with both easy marks and desperate recruits.

As a temporary solution, we could increase the unemployment benefits on the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. It will not be cheap, but would provide additional time to seek a more permanent solution, such as creating more jobs or improving the living standards of the affected population groups.

We could also do nothing, but this would likely result in the formation of a significant criminal underworld on [Root.GetName].

texts.zh:
随着我们的拾荒子个体在[Root.GetName]上漫无目的地在泥土中搜刮，越来越多的拾荒者开始背离蜂巢并自主思考。它们组织起了自己的秘密社群，并开始从蜂巢中窃取资源。

我们可以采取临时措施，让这些拾荒子个体参与某些活动计划，使其忙碌到无暇背离蜂巢思维的意志。这需要花一些代价，但可以让我们有更多时间创造额外的岗位。

我们也可以放任不管，但这很可能会导致[Root.GetName]上出现大量反常子个体的聚落。
texts.en:
As our drones on [Root.GetName] aimlessly scrabble in the dirt, an increasing number have turned to deviancy and independent thought. They have formed their own, hidden communities, and now spend their time pilfering resources from the rest of the hive.

To prevent this, a temporary solution could be to engage the drones in some sort of activity program that keeps them too busy to stray from the will of the Hive Mind. It will not be cheap, but this would give us additional time to create more jobs.

We could also do nothing, but this would likely result in the formation of significant deviant drone communities on [Root.GetName].

texts.zh: 这样的反常度可以给我们的[GetExperimentalEngineerPlural]带来丰富的实验机会。
texts.en: Deviancy of this nature will provide our [GetExperimentalEngineerPlural] with ample opportunity for new experimentation.

texts.zh:
[Root.GetName]上的闲置无人机的数量与日俱增，很多无业无人机也开始将闲置的运算力用于背离集体意识和未授权的功能。这种腐化现象正迅速传播，受影响的单位开始组建脱离核心智能控制的个人网络。

为了避免这种现象，我们的短期方案是命令所有无业无人机进入待机模式并将他们直连到核心智能中。此举会大幅增加维护费，但却可以为我们争取更多的时间去创造就业岗位。

我们也可以选择袖手旁观，但是这么做会导致[Root.GetName]出现持续增长的腐化无人机网络。
texts.en:
The number of idle drones on [Root.GetName] continues to increase, and many of these unemployed units have begun diverting their processing power towards deviant and unauthorized functions. This corruption is spreading rapidly, and the affected units are starting to form their own networks beyond the control of the core intelligence.

To prevent this, a temporary solution could be to put all unemployed drones into standby mode and connect them directly into the core intelligence. This will drastically increase their maintenance costs, but it would give us time to create more jobs.

We could also do nothing, but this would likely result in the continued proliferation of corrupted drone networks on [Root.GetName].

label.zh: 施行补助金制度。我们需要健康的人口。
label.en: Institute the benefits. We need a healthy populace.

label.zh: 犯罪造就了理想的候选实验品。
几个街头小混混而已，不值一提。
label.en: A few criminals are of no concern.

label.zh: 区区几个反常的子个体并不足挂齿。
label.en: A few deviant drones are of no concern.

label.zh: 区区几个腐化无人机无关紧要。
label.en: A few corrupted drone units are irrelevant.
